name: Custom root CAs (ssl-ca)
description: Installs custom root CA certificates (inline PEM, URLs checked against a sha256 you supply, or *.crt files already in the image) into the system trust store and every JDK cacerts it finds, and points the usual per-tool CA variables at the system bundle. List it first in overrideFeatureInstallOrder.

certs.description: Inline PEM certificate(s), e.g. "${localEnv:CORP_CA_PEM}". Literal newlines or \n escapes both work. Set it here, or as SSL_CA_CERTS in the image environment, or in the pins file.

urls.description: URL(s) of PEM or DER certificates (https, http or file), separated by commas or blanks. Each needs its sha256 in sha256s, in the same order. Set both here, or as SSL_CA_URLS and SSL_CA_SHA256S in the image environment, or in the pins file.

sha256s.description: One sha256 per URL in urls, in the same order, separated by commas or blanks. Set it in the same place as urls.

pins_file.description: Path of the pins file in the image, read for SSL_CA_CERTS, SSL_CA_URLS and SSL_CA_SHA256S when neither the options nor the image environment set them. Empty means /etc/devcontainer-features/pins.env.
